Players Committee card image of [[Captain Hera Syndulla (ALT) (Errata)]] (errata PC-E2), game text: “Adds 3 to power of anything she pilots. If with an Imperial (or two Rebels), adds one battle destiny. During battle, if you just drew a destiny < number of Rebels here, may cancel and redraw that destiny.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Light/large/captainherasyndulla_ai.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/b160bc3511d221ce14e57009aff2b36a62f5c004 b160bc3] (23 June 2021). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged.
